doc.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021

title: Expanding consciousness and closing
summary: Rowe quotes his 2009 statement; Smith says music should inspire, as Parker and Trane did, and the recording ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yeah, well I read a quote from you in 2009 regarding your music, “I was trying to expand the consciousness of humanity.”
And I think you’ve done that, and we appreciate it.

All right thanks, Monk. That’s what I was trying to do. That’s what music’s supposed to do man, because when I heard Charlie Parker that’s what he did for me, and then we used to go catch, I remember the Five Spot in the Village, you could stand outside and we’d listen to Trane perform and you’d listen to Trane play one set I mean that music could inspire you and carry you for weeks and months. I mean that’s what music’s supposed to do for you.
Awesome. Well on that note I’m going to pause our recording and then we’ll say our good-byes, all right?
